capabilities: Receive webhooks from external services and write their content into notes
Append user-defined Markdown payloads to a note
Authenticate the plugin with a login token from the companion service
Expose webhook URLs for use with automation services like IFTTT
extras: Setup requires signing up on the plugin author's companion web service and installing a login token; the signup link is stripped from the provided README, so the service URL is not stated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for outside apps, assistants, or automation services to write into your notes remotely.
summary: Webhook receiver plugin and companion service that lets external apps and automation services create or append to notes over HTTP.
